_comment: Tool name (case-insensitive, matched as a whole word/phrase) -> tracked affiliate URL to use whenever that tool is mentioned in a post/page. Add new deals here; automation/affiliate_link_sweep.py reads this file to find and insert/verify links across the site. Keep in sync with the 'outbound_link' field on the matching entry in data/tools_seed.json when the tool also has its own directory listing.
